treaty_name: Agreement between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2013, with Protocol), as modified by the MLI
eif_quote: De bepalingen van het Verdrag, met Protocol, zullen ingevolge artikel 29, eerste lid, van het Verdrag juncto de preambule tot het Protocol op 31 augustus 2014 in werking treden. | Art. 29(1): "This Agreement shall have effect as regards income derived during the taxable years and periods beginning on or after the first day of January next following the calendar year in which this Agreement enters into force."
source_title: Tractatenblad 2013, 104 (official Dutch treaty series, English text) - Wayback copy of zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl (live site returned HTTP 403)

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
in the case of royalties referred to in sub-paragraph a) of paragraph 3, 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties; and

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Dividends: Art. 10(3) - dividends beneficially owned by the other State's Government, its institutions or wholly state-owned entities are taxable only in the residence State (not modelled). MLI Art. 8(1): both China (listed agreement 17) and the Netherlands (listed agreement 13 China) notified Art. 10(2)(a), so the 365-day holding period applies to the 5% tier for WHT from 2023-01-01 (before that no holding period). Interest: Art. 11(3)-(4) exempt interest paid to/guaranteed by Government, local authority, Central Bank or listed wholly state-owned financial institutions (CDB, ADBC, China Exim, NSSF, Sinosure, CIC; FMO etc.). Royalties: Art. 12(2)(b) - equipment royalties 10% of the adjusted amount (60% of gross, i.e. effective 6%) - not modelled as separate tier. Treaty also has main-purpose anti-abuse clauses in Arts. 10(7), 11(9), 12(8). MLI WHT effective date from map.json (later MLI EIF 2022-09-01 -> 2023-01-01), SAT Announcement 2022 No.16 lists the treaty. Replaced the 1987 treaty from 2015-01-01 (Art. 29(2)).
unverified: MLI synthesised text (STA) not read; MLI application derived from China and Netherlands MLI positions (OECD) and map.json
